description: This file defines the EnableAllLayers class, a context manager for managing functorch vmap layers in PyTorch. It handles creation, cleanup, and conversion of batched tensors with functorch layers, specifically for enabling and managing dynamic batching layers.

classes.name: EnableAllLayers
classes.description: A context manager class for enabling and managing functorch vmap layers, including creation, cleanup, and tensor unwrapping.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the EnableAllLayers object, creating a list of Dim objects from provided DimEntry levels.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Enables functorch dynamic layers by incrementing nesting levels.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Cleans up dynamic layers by decrementing nesting levels in reverse order.

methods.name: from_batched
methods.description: Creates a Tensor object from a batched tensor by unwrapping functorch layers and assigning appropriate levels.

methods.name: inplace_update_layers
methods.description: Updates the levels of a batched tensor in place based on provided levels.
